etapes.en: Academic English prefers nouns to verbs (nominalisation) and cautious language (hedging).

exemples.en: The economy grew quickly. → The rapid growth of the economy…
exemples.fr: L'économie a grandi vite → La croissance rapide de l'économie…

etapes.en: The findings suggest that young people tend to read less
etapes.fr: Les résultats suggèrent que les jeunes ont tendance à lire moins
Il semble que la situation s'améliore.
reponses: It appears that the situation is improving.
It seems that the situation is improving.

etapes.en: To a certain extent, the hypothesis was confirmed.
choix: Dans une certaine mesure, l'hypothèse a été confirmée.

etapes.en: The results may suggest a significant change in behaviour.
etapes.fr: Les résultats pourraient suggérer un changement de comportement significatif.

resume: Nominalisation (decide → decision). Hedging: it appears that, may suggest, tend to, to a certain extent.
devoir: Rewrite a short paragraph from one of your school notes in academic style.
